Title: The Texas Bluebonnet
Content: (`1`) Every `text(spring)`, Texans look forward to the little blue dots that pop up in fields across the state. (`2`) As the `text(days)` go by, the dots appear to multiply. (`3`) Roadsides and hills take on a whole new look. (`4`) Meadows do too. (`5`) Before long, a beautiful blue blanket seems to cover parts of the landscape. (`6`) It is bluebonnet season in Texas. (`7`) Everyone loves it.

(`8`) The bluebonnet is a wildflower with bright blue petals. (`9`) Its color is somewhere between navy and royal blue. (`10`) When bluebonnets are grouped together, their blue coloring appears especially brilliant and bright.

(`11`) The bluebonnet grows best in full sunlight. (`12`) It thrives in places where there is little competition from other plants. (`13`) Over the `text(years)`, it has adapted to survive in even extreme weather. (`14`) It can endure the sudden cold fronts that are common in Texas in the `text(spring)`. (`15`) The bluebonnet does not usually require fertilizer or extra watering. (`16`) It is a sturdy and strong plant.

(`17`) However, this wildflower is not just a beautiful and hardy flower. (`18`) It is the state flower of Texas. (`19`) This makes it an important part of the state culture. (`20`) There are T-shirts, coffee mugs, and candles with bluebonnets on them. (`21`) They paint beautiful landscapes of bluebonnet fields. (`22`) The flower is the subject of Texas songs and folktales. (`23`) `text(One)` historian, Jack Maguire, wrote, “The bluebonnet is to Texas what the shamrock is to Ireland.”

(`24`) Unfortunately, people must wait to enjoy this beautiful flower `text(each year)`. (`25`) That’s because the bluebonnet is an `text(annual)` flower. (`26`) That means it blooms just `text(once a year)`. (`27`) The bluebonnet usually appears in `text(March)` or `text(April)` and to last through `text(early May)`.

(`28`) `text(Once)` the flowers begin to appear, many people drive around the state to see the beautiful bluebonnet fields. (`29`) Families and friends gather to take pictures in the fields. (`30`) Some people even take pictures of their pets surrounded by the beautiful flowers. (`31`) Small towns across the state host bluebonnet festivals. (`32`) `text(One)` festival draws `text(thousands)` of people to Burnet, Texas, `text(each spring)`. (`33`) Celebrations include live music, parades, `text(5K)` races, and more.

(`34`) The bluebonnet is a unique and beautiful flower. (`35`) It adorns the hills and fields of Texas `text(each spring)`. (`36`) The gorgeous blue wildflower is celebrated and admired by people across the state.
